description: The file contains functions and logic for managing 'converters' within the BORIS software, including adding, modifying, deleting, and loading converters, as well as UI interactions and execution of user-written Python code for conversions.

methods.name: pb_code_help_clicked(self)
methods.description: Displays an informational message box explaining how to write converters in Python.

methods.name: add_converter(self)
methods.description: Enables UI elements for adding a new converter and disables other related buttons.

methods.name: modify_converter(self)
methods.description: Enables editing UI fields for a selected converter and disables other UI components.

methods.name: code_2_func(self, name: str, code: str)
methods.description: Converts a string of Python code into a Python function string that wraps the code, adding decode logic and a return statement.

methods.name: save_converter(self)
methods.description: Validates input, converts code to a function, executes it to verify syntax, and then saves it into the UI table; marks the project as modified.

methods.name: cancel_converter(self)
methods.description: Cancels the current converter editing process, resetting and disabling relevant UI elements.

methods.name: delete_converter(self)
methods.description: Confirms and removes the selected converter from the UI table.

methods.name: load_converters_from_file_repo(self, mode: str)
methods.description: Loads converter definitions from a local JSON file or remote BORIS repository, handling conflicts, syntax errors, and integrating the loaded converters into the UI.
